description: Ultimate Disc High-Performance Road/Aero Road The Ultimate: Two-wheeled perfection What happens when you push a team of riders, engineers and craftsmen to create the most technologically-advanced titanium road racing platform? When you take off the limiters, the best imaginable ride is the result. That’s the Ultimate. Indeed, it’s no overreach to say the Ultimate exemplifies all the things required in a pro-level performance race bike. Light weight, aerodynamics, stiffness, compliance and the unsurpassed stopping power of disc brakes are all delivered in deftly-handcrafted titanium bike making it the most technically-advanced race machine available—anywhere. The result is a design so special, so all-encompassing, it’s truly deserving of its legendary name. There are few road bike models with the lasting heritage of the Ultimate. It was first introduced as Litespeed’s premier 3AL-2.5V titanium race bike, utilizing our most progressive designs to create a bike with exceptional handling and stiffness characteristics. A USPRO national championship, several stage victories, even a UCI World Road Racing Championship—rebadged— were amassed on Litespeed’s then flagship model. Today, that heritage lives on, but the ceiling of what’s possible in a race bike has been raised to an even higher standard. Our team of craftsmen have pushed the envelope of what’s possible to create the finest titanium race machine. Thin, swept seatstays deliver both enhanced comfort and wind-cheating aerodynamics. All the frame’s tubesets have been shaped with purpose, promising out-of-saddle sprint stiffness and responsive climbing acumen, all delivered at premium level with a geometry that delivers that perfect balance of handling quickness, light climbing punch. The Litespeed Ultimate Disc adds the benefits of disc braking, making long descents and hard, late stopping no problem. The design also allows us to create greater frame clearance on the Ultimate Disc, permitting for the use of up to 35mm tires. When it comes to traction, control and speed, it simply doesn’t get any better. And being a Litespeed, it delivers that signature titanium ride; stiff as you want, but over the long hours, comfortable as the material absorbs the buzz out of even the roughest chip-sealed roads. This is the best of the best in titanium. Don’t see your dream build of the Ultimate among our offerings? Whether it’s SRAM 1X build, a brilliant custom colorway paint at the hands of our painting team, a special bar and stem request, or custom wheels, we can accommodate most any request, with additional costs and lead times, allowing your Ultimate Disc to truly be built into the ride of your dreams. Our team in Tennessee is ready to make your Ultimate your definition of two-wheeled perfection. Key Features High performance road/aero road Full 3AL/2.5V titanium frame featuring Aeroform design with bladed seatstays for vertical compliance as well as aerodynamic benefit Litespeed-specific truncated airfoil downtube, and quadrilaterally-formed top tube delivering stiffness and precision handling characteristics Optimized for clearance on up to 35mm tires (most tire/rim combinations) Lightweight, butted bottom bracket and head tube Internal Di2 and hydraulic disc cable routing Replaceable derailleur hanger Bright Brushed Litespeed Finish option and decal option provided standard Full range of custom paint upgrade options available Custom component options available upon request PF30 bottom bracket, with T47 bottom bracket upgrade available Proudly handcrafted in Chattanooga, TN using globally sourced premium materials Frame sizes: XS, S, M, ML, L, XL and custom Average weight for size medium frame: 1,323 grams We pair each Litespeed frame with some of the best components and drivetrains in the world.
